note: Industry solutions in the Copilot Studio Gallery shape: metadata, README and the exploded unmanaged solution per folder.

solutions.name: Account Intelligence Agent
solutions.description: Bring account context, stakeholder coverage, competitor signals, risks, and draft talking points into a single reviewable briefing for sellers and customer-success teams.

solutions.name: Customer Escalations Agent
solutions.description: Bring fictional case history, knowledge guidance, routing rules, and quality signals into one reviewable brief so service teams can respond consistently without letting the agent touch a customer record.

solutions.name: Ask HR Agent
solutions.description: Give employees a privacy-conscious self-service front door for fictional balances and published policy examples, while keeping eligibility, sensitive circumstances, submissions, and HR decisions with authorized people and systems.

solutions.name: Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent
solutions.description: Bring synthetic condition, failure-window, maintenance-budget, and work-planning evidence into one reliability brief while keeping every work order, schedule, and field instruction behind authorized systems.

solutions.name: Benefits Enrollment Agent
solutions.description: Give employees a conversational guide to the enrollment window, life-event rules, plan costs for their tier, provider networks, missing documents, and a draft election, while eligibility, plan choice, and submission stay with the employee and benefits staff.

solutions.name: Briefing Pack Builder Agent
solutions.description: Give government briefing teams cited, template-ready drafts from one governed document set, with conflicting figures listed for a person to settle and missing sections named, while review and sign-off stay with officers.

solutions.name: Build Materials Compliance Agent
solutions.description: Give a contractor's procurement team one assistant that scans the approved bills of materials every week, flags items that newly fall out of the program's materials sourcing rule with cited evidence, finds same-spec compliant alternates, and keeps the audit evidence package ready.

solutions.name: Building Permit Processing Agent

solutions.name: Campaign Delivery Optimizer Agent

solutions.name: Care Gap Closure Agent
solutions.description: Help quality and care-coordination teams inspect synthetic measure evidence, organize operational review cohorts, and draft unsent outreach while preserving clinical eligibility and privacy review.

solutions.name: Cart Abandonment Recovery Agent
solutions.description: Analyzes anonymous synthetic cart patterns, drafts neutral channel sequences, compares margin-aware incentive concepts, and reviews aggregate conversion scenarios.

solutions.name: Claims Processing Agent
solutions.description: Bring intake, policy terms, documents, fraud indicators, and nonbinding settlement estimates into one adjuster workspace without claiming approval, denial, payment, or coverage action.

solutions.name: Client Health Score Agent
solutions.description: Help client success leaders and account managers segment relationship health, spot weakening engagement, prioritize turnaround accounts, and prepare stakeholder-led recovery plans without presenting scenario indicators as certain outcomes.

solutions.name: Clinical Notes Summarizer Agent
solutions.description: Give clinical teams consistent synthetic encounter, medication, problem-list, and referral-context drafts while keeping diagnosis, treatment, clearance, urgency, scheduling, and record changes with qualified humans.

solutions.name: Content Launch Clearance Agent

solutions.name: Contract Risk Review Agent

solutions.name: Cross-Selling Opportunities Agent

solutions.name: Customer Loyalty and Rewards Agent

solutions.name: Customer Sentiment and Churn Prediction Agent

solutions.name: Deal Progression Agent

solutions.name: Emissions Tracking Agent

solutions.name: Regulatory Reporting Agent

solutions.name: Field Service Dispatch Agent

solutions.name: Financial Advisor Agent

solutions.name: Fraud Detection and Alert Agent

solutions.name: Customer Onboarding Agent

solutions.name: Regulatory Compliance Agent

solutions.name: Inventory Rebalancing Agent

solutions.name: Maintenance Scheduling Agent

solutions.name: Omnichannel Engagement Agent

solutions.name: Order Status Communications Agent

solutions.name: Permit Management Agent

solutions.name: Portfolio Rebalancing Agent

solutions.name: Prior Authorization Agent

solutions.name: Procurement Agent
